args.text: CREATE TABLE One (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_One PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE Den (Id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Den PRIMARY KEY, Denominator LONG, TextValue TEXT(20))
INSERT INTO Den (Id, Denominator, TextValue) VALUES (1, 2, '12')
INSERT INTO Den (Id, Denominator, TextValue) VALUES (2, 0, 'abc')
INSERT INTO Den (Id, Denominator, TextValue) VALUES (3, Null, Null)
CREATE TABLE Dm (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Dm PRIMARY KEY, G TEXT(10), V DOUBLE, N LONG, S TEXT(20), DT DATETIME)
INSERT INTO Dm (ID, G, V, N, S, DT) VALUES (3, 'a', Null, 30, Null, Null)
INSERT INTO Dm (ID, G, V, N, S, DT) VALUES (4, 'b', 4.0, Null, 'x', #2023-03-17 00:00:00#)
INSERT INTO Dm (ID, G, V, N, S, DT) VALUES (6, Null, 6.5, 60, 'q''r', #2023-03-18 00:00:00#)
CREATE TABLE Mx (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Mx PRIMARY KEY, N LONG, T TEXT(30), D DOUBLE, DT DATETIME, Y YESNO)
CREATE TABLE Pn (Id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Pn PRIMARY KEY, G TEXT(10), S TEXT(50))
CREATE TABLE Vals (ID INTEGER CONSTRAINT PK_Vals PRIMARY KEY, B BYTE, I SMALLINT, L INTEGER, S REAL, D FLOAT, C CURRENCY, M DECIMAL(28,4), DT DATETIME, Y BIT, T TEXT(50), Q TEXT(50), N INTEGER)
UPDATE Vals SET M = -1844674407370955.1621 WHERE ID = 1
SELECT ID, M, VarType(M) AS vt, TypeName(M) AS tn, CStr(M) AS cs FROM Vals
SELECT (SELECT Count(*) FROM One) AS one, (SELECT Count(*) FROM Den) AS den, (SELECT Count(*) FROM Dm) AS dm, (SELECT Count(*) FROM Mx) AS mx, (SELECT Count(*) FROM Pn) AS pn FROM One
